question.text: The rate of time value erosion (time decay) in options is:

answer.text: Non-linear — it accelerates as the expiry date approaches
Linear — equal amount of decay each day
Exponential — faster at the start, slower near expiry
Zero until the last week before expiry

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, time decay is not linear — the rate of erosion increases as the expiry date approaches. The Trap: Decay is not equal per day (not linear), not faster early then slower near expiry, and does not begin only in the final week. Note: Erosion proceeds throughout the life of the option but accelerates as expiry nears.
